author: OldManTigerMask
body:
Alright so I'm Tiger  and I thought of this feature that I'm certain the majority of you would want.

All of us (or most of us) have had the experience where you've had to tediously press reply, reply, reply to reply to a person. I know you could just do @Username, then the message then enter and @Username, etc. But this doesn't notify the user (unless they're subscribed) which means it can get very tedious and annoying to press reply. Not only that but it also spams and fills up the page with your replies and we all HATE spam.

So I propose a multi-reply feature, similar to the Minecraft Forums multi-reply feature where you just click "Multi Reply" under each comment and it automatically puts the reply inside the post section below, then it just works similar to replying to a post but is highlighted for each user you want to multi-reply to.

Hopefully, I made that clear to y'all and if you have any questions feel free to ask below.

Thanks,
Tiger

I hope to hear your feedback! :D

replies.author: keenanjt
replies.body: Okay, if I am understanding the concept you are describing correctly... It may seem simple from an outsiders perspective. From the development side, it's a big task. The foundation of the forums prevents multiple replies for one post, and if we were to hack on support for multiple replies, the forums would more than likely experience some slower performance. We're not going to look into this as it is not a priority - yes I say that a lot, but it's very much so been the case recently as us devs are spread thin and really want Atlas out. Multiple posts for replies to multiple people is fine, unless it gets too spammy.
